The watchlist

Your seat on the sofa
is waiting.

Your resident cinephile couple in Wellesley has finally turned “we should do movie nights” into an actual plan: a weekly movie night. Our watchlist is wildly out of hand, and we’d much rather work through it with you.

Vote for anything you fancy below, or suggest a film we’ve missed. Your votes help us choose the next film. Check the screening below for the confirmed date and time. Join the email list below and we’ll send you a weekly reminder with that night’s film and a link to save your seat.

There’s unlimited microwave popcorn. On days when the hosts are feeling ambitious, there may even be proper, delicious snacks. You’re very welcome to bring something to share, too.
